name: Water intake
description: Intake of a drinking water source

name: Screening
description: Raw water screening by screening filters

name: Algae screening
description: Raw water screening by micro sieving filters to remove algae

name: Coagulation
description: Addition of inorganic or organic chemicals, i.e. coagulants, to assist in the removal of particles in suspended water.

name: Flocculation
description: Process which occurs after addition or dosing of coagulants

name: Submerged rapid sand filtration
description: A separation treatment stage where particles, metal ions and dissolved substances are removed by the aid of sand particle media. Filters are cleaned by backflushing or backwashing.

name: Softening
description: The softening process lowers the hardness of water

name: Aeration
description: Artificially induced addition of air to enable oxidation and gas stripping (e.g. carbon dioxide, methane, hydrogen sulfide and volatile organic compounds).

name: Disinfection
description: Inactivation of viruses, micro-organisms and protozoa

name: Ultra- and microfiltration
description: In ultra- and microfiltration systems, dissolved substances are filtered out by polymer or ceramic membranes with microscopic pores. The type of membrane media determines the amount of pressure that is needed to drive the water through the filter.

name: Sedimentation
description: After flocculation, water is fed into a sedimentation basin, also referred as a clarifier or settling basin.

name: Clean water storage
description: Storage of drinking water in drinking water reservoir storage
